business_problem: BORICA needed to modernize national fraud prevention so it could stop fast, cross-channel attacks in milliseconds without disrupting legitimate payment traffic across multiple banks and service providers.
solution_summary: BORICA partnered with IBM and IBS to replace fragmented, batch-oriented fraud controls with a centralized, real-time decisioning platform built on IBM Safer Payments. The solution introduced a multi-tenant architecture that serves participating banks and payment service providers from a shared national platform rather than requiring separate local controls. IBM Safer Payments uses in-memory processing, machine-learning-driven detection and horizontal scalability to score card and digital-payment activity as it happens, while IBS integrated the platform directly into BORICA’s payment workflows. This changed fraud handling from slow rules and delayed review into behavioral, real-time monitoring that can cover card transactions, AML checks and new channels such as instant payments. The architecture gives BORICA national-scale protection, consistent controls across institutions and room to extend the model as transaction volumes and attack patterns evolve.

solution_components.name: IBM Safer Payments
solution_components.role: Performs real-time behavioral fraud and AML scoring for transactions across BORICA’s payment ecosystem.

data_flow: Payment events flow from participating banks and PSPs into IBM Safer Payments, which scores activity in memory and returns fraud and AML decisions directly into BORICA’s shared payment workflows in real time.
business_outcome: BORICA now operates a centralized fraud platform that protects most domestic card traffic in real time, scales to high transaction volumes and improves resilience across the national payment ecosystem.
architecture_clues: Designed to expand across institutions and digital channels
evidence_quotes: BORICA partnered with IBM and implementation partner IBS to modernize its national fraud prevention architecture.
Together, they deployed IBM Safer Payments as a centralized, multi-tenant platform replacing legacy batch-based systems with real-time behavioral risk scoring.
The system processes 4,000+ transactions per second with sub-10 millisecond latency.
